'''Science and technology'''
*Argentine mathematician [[Luis Caffarelli]] wins this year's [[Abel Prize]] "for his seminal contributions to regularity theory for nonlinear partial differential equations including free-boundary problems and the [[Monge–Ampère equation]]". He becomes the first Latin American to win this prize. [https://amp.theguardian.com/science/2023/mar/22/the-messi-of-maths-argentinian-luis-caffarelli-wins-abel-prize (''The Guardian'')]
*American engineer [[Robert Metcalfe]] wins this year's [[Turing Award]] for the invention of [[Ethernet]]. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/computing-networking-pioneer-metcalfe-wins-top-industry-prize-2023-03-22/ (Reuters)]
